key_insight: DreamVideo-Omni unifies precise, multi-granularity motion control and strong multi-subject identity preservation by introducing latent identity reinforcement learning inside a diffusion-based video customization pipeline.
problem_solved: Addresses identity degradation, motion-control ambiguity, and limited motion granularity in multi-subject video synthesis, enabling faithful identity retention and fine-to-coarse motion control for multiple subjects simultaneously.
method: Omni-motion control module that supports multi-granularity motion signals (pose, trajectory, and high-level motion prompts) and routes them per subject within a single framework.
Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning: a reinforcement signal in latent space that explicitly rewards identity preservation during diffusion-based video customization to prevent identity drift.
Integrated multi-subject conditioning and fusion strategies to resolve cross-subject interference and maintain coherent interactions while generating temporally consistent videos.
impact: Enables practitioners to generate customizable multi-person videos with stronger identity fidelity and precise motion specification, improving downstream tasks like avatar creation, virtual production, and personalized content generation.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram showing inputs (multi-subject images + multi-granularity motion controls) → diffusion backbone → latent identity RL loop → output video.
Before/after comparison frames highlighting identity preservation improvements (baseline vs DreamVideo-Omni).
Multi-granularity motion visualization (pose keypoints, trajectory paths, and high-level motion timelines) mapped to multiple subjects.
Schematic of the latent identity reinforcement signal: reward computation and feedback into the diffusion steps.
paper_title: DreamVideo-Omni: Omni-Motion Controlled Multi-Subject Video Customization with Latent Identity Reinforcement Learning
paper_authors: Yujie Wei, Xinyu Liu, Shiwei Zhang, Hangjie Yuan, Jinbo Xing
